answers.question: Find the number of matches happened in each year.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT year, COUNT(*) as match_count FROM matches GROUP BY year

answers.question: What are the names and ranks of the three youngest winners across all matches?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT winner_name, winner_rank FROM matches INNER JOIN players ON matches.winner_id = players.player_id ORDER BY winner_age ASC LIMIT 3

answers.question: Find the first name, country code and birth date of the winner who has the highest rank points in all matches.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code, p.birth_date FROM players p JOIN matches m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE p.player_id = ( SELECT winner_id FROM matches ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1 )

What are the different ids and names of the battles that lost any 'Brig' type shipes?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT id, name FROM battle WHERE id IN (SELECT lost_in_battle FROM ship WHERE ship_type = 'Brig')

answers.question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT b.id, b.name FROM battle b JOIN death d ON b.id = (SELECT lost_in_battle FROM ship WHERE ship.id = d.caused_by_ship_id) GROUP BY b.id, b.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
